rules.name: OrdersRootExists
rules.description: The XML document must contain an Orders root element.
rules.message: The root <Orders> element must exist in the XML document.

rules.name: OrderElementExists
rules.description: There must be at least one Order element.
rules.message: At least one <Order> element must exist under <Orders>.

rules.name: OrderIdRequired
rules.description: Every Order element must have an id attribute.
rules.message: The Order id attribute is required and must not be blank.

rules.name: OrderIdFormat
rules.description: Order ID must follow the pattern ORD-XXXXXX.
rules.message: Order id must match the pattern ORD-XXXXXX (e.g. ORD-000001).

rules.name: OrderIdUnique
rules.description: Order IDs must be unique within the import file.
rules.message: Order id must be unique — duplicate value detected.

rules.name: OrderStatusRequired
rules.description: Every Order must have a Status element.
rules.message: The <Status> element is required on every Order.

rules.name: OrderStatusAllowedValues
rules.description: Order status must be one of the permitted values.
rules.message: Order Status must be one of: Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled.

rules.name: CustomerNameRequired
rules.description: Every Order must have a CustomerName element.
rules.message: The <CustomerName> element is required on every Order.

rules.name: CustomerNameMinLength
rules.description: Customer name must be at least 2 characters.
rules.message: CustomerName must be at least 2 characters long.

rules.name: TotalAmountRequired
rules.description: Every Order must have a TotalAmount element.
rules.message: The <TotalAmount> element is required on every Order.

rules.name: TotalAmountNumericRange
rules.description: Order total must be a positive number not exceeding 1,000,000.
rules.message: TotalAmount must be a positive number no greater than 1,000,000.

rules.name: OrderDateFormat
rules.description: Order date must be in ISO 8601 date format.
rules.message: OrderDate must be in yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 2026-01-31).

rules.name: CurrencyCodeAllowedValues
rules.description: Currency code must be a supported ISO 4217 code.
rules.message: Currency must be one of the supported codes: GBP, USD, EUR, CAD, AUD.
